## Purpose and runtime entry points
Radarr is a self-hosted movie collection manager. Its .NET backend tracks movies, searches RSS/indexers, selects releases, delegates downloads, imports/renames media, and exposes a versioned API plus a browser UI. Host startup is in `src/NzbDrone.Host/Bootstrap.cs` and `src/NzbDrone.Host/Startup.cs`; the console application is `src/NzbDrone.Console/ConsoleApp.cs`. The browser client boots from `frontend/src/index.ts` through `frontend/src/bootstrap.tsx`.

## Host, HTTP, and API boundary
The Host runs the application lifetime, HTTP pipeline, host filtering, forwarding, and single-instance policy. `Radarr.Http` supplies authentication, error handling, static frontend mapping, REST abstractions, and middleware; `Radarr.Api.V3` adapts core services to `/api/v3` resources. Key boundaries:
- Host/runtime: `src/NzbDrone.Host/Startup.cs`, `src/NzbDrone.Host/AppLifetime.cs`
- HTTP/auth/frontend serving: `src/Radarr.Http/Authentication/AuthenticationService.cs`, `src/Radarr.Http/Frontend/StaticResourceController.cs`
- API controllers/resources: `src/Radarr.Api.V3/Movies/MovieController.cs`, `src/Radarr.Api.V3/Indexers/ReleaseController.cs`

## Core domain and persistence
`NzbDrone.Core` contains domain services, repositories, configuration, validation, and orchestration. Movies, metadata, collections, files, history, profiles, tags, and provider definitions are persisted behind repository/service layers. The datastore supports SQLite and PostgreSQL-oriented query construction and has a long migration chain, making schema evolution a material operational boundary.
- Domain lifecycle: `src/NzbDrone.Core/Movies/MovieService.cs`, `src/NzbDrone.Core/Movies/AddMovieService.cs`
- Persistence/migrations: `src/NzbDrone.Core/Datastore/MainDatabase.cs`, `src/NzbDrone.Core/Datastore/Migration/Framework/MigrationController.cs`
- Configuration: `src/NzbDrone.Core/Configuration/ConfigService.cs`

## Discovery, search, and release decisions
Scheduled RSS sync and explicit movie searches query configured indexers, parse feeds/releases into normalized models, then pass candidates through the decision engine. The engine applies availability, movie monitoring, quality/custom-format profiles, size, language, history/blocklist, queue, retention, and upgrade constraints; accepted releases are prioritized before download submission.
- Indexer integration/sync: `src/NzbDrone.Core/Indexers/RssSyncService.cs`, `src/NzbDrone.Core/Indexers/FetchAndParseRssService.cs`
- Search: `src/NzbDrone.Core/IndexerSearch/ReleaseSearchService.cs`
- Decision boundary: `src/NzbDrone.Core/DecisionEngine/DownloadDecisionMaker.cs`, `src/NzbDrone.Core/DecisionEngine/Specifications/QualityAllowedByProfileSpecification.cs`

## Download-to-library pipeline
Accepted decisions are processed through pluggable Usenet/torrent download clients. Monitoring refreshes remote queue state, handles failures or pending releases, then completed-download processing scans and imports files. Import decisions aggregate release/file/media metadata, reject unsuitable files, move/copy into movie folders, update database records, and can rename according to naming rules.
- Download orchestration: `src/NzbDrone.Core/Download/ProcessDownloadDecisions.cs`, `src/NzbDrone.Core/Download/DownloadMonitoringService.cs`
- Client plugin boundary: `src/NzbDrone.Core/Download/DownloadClientFactory.cs`, `src/NzbDrone.Core/Download/Clients/Sabnzbd/Sabnzbd.cs`
- Import/filesystem boundary: `src/NzbDrone.Core/MediaFiles/DownloadedMovieImportService.cs`, `src/NzbDrone.Core/MediaFiles/MovieImport/ImportDecisionMaker.cs`, `src/NzbDrone.Core/Organizer/FileNameBuilder.cs`

## Asynchronous control and event propagation
Long-running work is represented as persisted commands, queued/executed by command infrastructure and scheduled by the job scheduler. Domain events decouple post-processing such as notifications, refreshes, and UI updates. SignalR broadcasts resource changes/progress to connected frontend clients.
- Commands/jobs: `src/NzbDrone.Core/Messaging/Commands/CommandQueue.cs`, `src/NzbDrone.Core/Messaging/Commands/CommandExecutor.cs`, `src/NzbDrone.Core/Jobs/Scheduler.cs`
- In-process events: `src/NzbDrone.Core/Messaging/Events/EventAggregator.cs`
- Realtime boundary: `src/NzbDrone.SignalR/MessageHub.cs`, `frontend/src/Components/SignalRConnector.js`

## Frontend application and integrations
The React TypeScript/JavaScript SPA uses a centralized store with actions, selectors, reducers, persistence, and Sentry middleware. Routes compose movie, activity/queue, calendar, discovery, import, system, and settings views against the API. Settings configure external indexers, import lists (TMDb, Trakt, Plex, etc.), download clients, metadata consumers, media servers, and notification providers. Outbound network access uses common HTTP/proxy/TLS services.
- App routing/state: `frontend/src/App/AppRoutes.tsx`, `frontend/src/Store/createAppStore.js`
- Movie/queue UI: `frontend/src/Movie/Index/MovieIndex.tsx`, `frontend/src/Activity/Queue/Queue.tsx`
- External service abstractions: `src/NzbDrone.Common/Http/HttpClient.cs`, `src/NzbDrone.Core/ImportLists/ImportListFactory.cs`, `src/NzbDrone.Core/Notifications/NotificationFactory.cs`
